name: A Simple Re:Quest
source:
During a month off from your contract position, you join a locally-based augmented reality game (ARG) lasting from early December to the winter solstice.

Frostkyn's Quest requires teams of two players, though…
So who's the game paired you with?

[From [url=https://jettbarker.itch.io/a-simple-request]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在合同职位休息一个月期间，你将参加一个本地增强现实游戏 (ARG)，该游戏从12月初持续到冬至。

Frostkyn的任务需要两名玩家组成团队，不过……
那么这款游戏让你和谁配对呢？

[来自[url=https://jettbarker.itch.io/a-simple-request]itch.io[/url]]
